scientific_integrity: Fourth-order extrapolation, Strang splitting, and its delayed multi-product combination are attributed to existing literature. New assessment concerns an exact Markov positivity classification, not the introduction of an integrator. Independent validation is outstanding.
scientific_limitations: The universal assertion is for all row Markov generators of size at most two. The sharp cutoff in dimension three is for the displayed two-edge equal-rate pure-birth split; it is not a universal three-state cutoff. Exact arithmetic only; no claim of global positivity for all larger systems.
title: Latency-invariant three-state positivity frontier for extrapolated Strang splitting
